instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
While pasta is cooking, cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp. Remove bacon from skillet, reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings in the skillet. Crumble bacon.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and parmesan cheese.
Drain pasta and add to skillet with bacon drippings. Toss to coat.
Remove skillet from heat and stir in egg mixture and crumbled bacon. The heat from the pasta will cook the eggs. Season with black pepper and serve immediately.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Coat chicken breasts in breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
Pour marinara sauce into a baking dish. Place chicken on top of sauce and top with mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until chicken is cooked through and cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve with spaghetti.
In a large skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in taco seasoning and 1/2 cup of water. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until sauce has thickened.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Fill taco shells with beef mixture and top with lettuce, tomato, cheese, and sour cream.
In a large skillet or wok, heat olive oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned.
Add broccoli and carrots to skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until tender-crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, ginger, and garlic.
Pour sauce over chicken and vegetables and toss to coat. Cook for 2-3 minutes, or until sauce has thickened.
Serve with rice.
In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion, carrots, and celery and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, vegetable broth, and diced tomatoes. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until potatoes are tender.
Stir in thyme and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Wash and chop romaine lettuce.
In a large bowl, combine lettuce, croutons, and parmesan cheese.
Drizzle with Caesar dressing and toss to coat.
Top with grilled chicken breast, if desired.
Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C).
Roll out pizza dough on a lightly floured surface.
Spread pizza sauce over dough and top with mozzarella cheese and pepperoni.
Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until crust is golden brown and cheese is melted and bubbly.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk and egg.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and whisk until just combined. Do not overmix.
Melt butter in a large skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter onto skillet for each pancake. Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
Serve with butter and maple syrup.
Preheat waffle iron.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk and egg.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and whisk until just combined. Do not overmix.
Stir in melted butter.
Pour batter onto waffle iron and cook according to manufacturer's directions.
In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs, milk, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Dip each slice of bread into egg mixture, coating both sides.
Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add bread to skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
Serve with butter and maple syrup.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Heat a lightly oiled skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour in egg mixture and cook until set.
Sprinkle with cheese, ham, onion, and bell pepper.
Fold omelette in half and serve.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Pour in egg mixture and cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are cooked to your liking.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.
Cook macaroni according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Stir in flour to form a paste.
Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in cheese until melted.
Add macaroni and stir to coat. Serve immediately.
Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Place one slice of bread, butter-side down, in a skillet over medium heat.
Top with cheese and another slice of bread, butter-side up.
Cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cheese is melted.
Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp. Drain on paper towels.
Toast bread to your liking.
Spread mayonnaise on one side of each slice of toast.
Layer bacon, lettuce, and tomato on one slice of toast. Top with another slice of toast.
In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a boil.
Add chicken, egg noodles, carrots, celery, and onion. Cook for 10-12 minutes, or until noodles are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Remove chicken from pot and shred. Return to pot and serve.
In a large pot, combine diced tomatoes, vegetable broth, onion, and garlic. Bring to a simmer and cook for 15-20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to blend soup until smooth.
Stir in heavy cream and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Peel and cube potatoes. Place in a large pot and cover with water. Bring to a boil and cook for 15-20 minutes, or until tender.
Drain potatoes and return to pot. Mash with a potato masher or electric mixer.
Stir in butter, milk, salt, and pepper. Serve immediately.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Wash and dry potato. Prick several times with a fork.
Bake for 45-60 minutes, or until tender.
Cut a slit in the top of the potato and top with butter, sour cream, cheese, and bacon bits.
Peel and cut potatoes into fries.
Heat oil in a large skillet or deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Fry potatoes for 5-7 minutes, or until golden brown.
Drain on paper towels and season with salt.
In a medium bowl, mash avocados.
Stir in onion, tomato, lime juice, cilantro, and salt.
Serve with tortilla chips.
In a food processor, combine all ingredients and pulse until desired consistency is reached.
Serve with tortilla chips.
Place a tortilla in a large skillet over medium heat.
Sprinkle with cheese and chicken.
Top with another tortilla and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cheese is melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa and sour cream.
Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Spread tortilla chips on a baking sheet.
Top with cheese, ground beef, and refried beans.
Bake for 5-7 minutes, or until cheese is melted.
Top with salsa and sour cream.
Warm tortillas according to package directions.
Fill each tortilla with ground beef, refried beans, cheese, and rice.
Fold in sides and roll up.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Dip each tortilla in enchilada sauce to coat.
Fill each tortilla with chicken and cheese.
Roll up and place in a baking dish.
Pour remaining enchilada sauce over tortillas and top with cheese.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until heated through and cheese is melted and bubbly.
In a large skillet, cook chicken, bell peppers, and onion over medium-high heat until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Stir in fajita seasoning and cook for 1 minute more.
Serve with warm tortillas and your favorite toppings.
In a large pot, cook ground beef and onion over medium-high heat until beef is browned. Drain off excess fat.
Stir in kidney beans, diced tomatoes, chili powder, and cumin. Bring to a simmer and cook for 30-45 minutes, or until flavors have blended.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together egg, milk, and oil.
Pour wet ingredients into dry ingredients and whisk until just combined. Do not overmix.
Pour batter into a greased 9-inch square baking pan.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until a wooden skewer inserted into the center comes out clean.
Bake biscuits according to package directions.
While biscuits are baking, cook sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned. Crumble sausage and remove from skillet, reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings in the skillet.
Stir in flour to form a paste. Gradually whisk in milk until smooth. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly.
Stir in sausage and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve gravy over biscuits.
In a large bowl, combine ground beef, minced onion, minced garlic, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Form the mixture into patties.
Grill or pan-fry the patties to your desired doneness.
Serve on hamburger buns with lettuce, tomato, and cheese.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Pour in white wine and lemon juice, and bring to a simmer.
Stir in cooked spaghetti and parsley. Serve immediately.
In a large saucepan, heat vegetable broth to a simmer.
In a separate large pot, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened.
Add mushrooms and cook until browned.
Stir in arborio rice and cook for 1 minute more.
Pour in white wine and cook until absorbed.

Add a ladle of vegetable broth and cook until absorbed, stirring constantly. Continue adding broth one ladle at a time, allowing each to be absorbed before adding the next, until the rice is creamy and cooked through.
Stir in parmesan cheese and serve.
In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add chicken and cook until cooked through. Remove chicken and shred.
In a separate bowl, combine flour, baking powder, and salt. Stir in milk to form a dough.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into the boiling broth. Cook for 10-12 minutes, or until dumplings are cooked through.
Return shredded chicken to the pot along with carrots, celery, and onion. Simmer until vegetables are tender.
Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Rub the chicken with olive oil, salt, pepper, rosemary, and thyme.
Stuff the cavity with a halved lemon and garlic cloves.
Place potatoes and carrots around the chicken in a roasting pan.
Roast for 1 to 1.5 hours, or until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and spices.
In another bowl, mix pumpkin puree, egg, and milk.
Combine wet and dry ingredients until just mixed.
Melt butter on a griddle and pour batter to form pancakes. Cook until bubbles appear, then flip and cook until golden brown.
Sauté onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in a large pot.
Add vegetable broth and diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Stir in kidney beans and pasta. Simmer until pasta is tender.
Stir in spinach until wilted. Season and serve.
Mash black beans in a bowl.
Mix in breadcrumbs, minced onion, garlic, cumin, chili powder, and egg.
Form into patties and pan-fry or bake until firm.
Serve on buns with your favorite toppings.
Combine mango chunks, yogurt, milk, sugar, and a pinch of cardamom in a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy.
Serve chilled.
In a large bowl, combine spinach, pomegranate seeds, and walnuts.
Crumble goat cheese over the top.
Drizzle with balsamic vinaigrette and toss to serve.
Cook rice according to package directions.
Once cooked, fluff the rice with a fork and stir in chopped cilantro, lime juice, and salt.
In a skillet, heat olive oil and sauté minced garlic and red chili flakes.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice over the shrimp and garnish with fresh parsley.
Cook pasta. While it cooks, sauté onion and garlic.
Add diced tomatoes and simmer.
Stir in heavy cream and spinach until the spinach wilts.
Combine with the pasta and top with parmesan cheese.
Slice beef thinly. In a bowl, toss beef with soy sauce and cornstarch.
In a wok or large skillet, stir-fry beef until browned. Remove from wok.
Add broccoli, ginger, and garlic to the wok and stir-fry until tender-crisp.
Return beef to the wok, add more soy sauce if needed, and heat through.
Serve over rice.
Cook ziti pasta until al dente.
In a separate pan, brown the ground beef and drain.
In a large bowl, mix the cooked ziti, ricotta cheese, half of the marinara sauce, and the ground beef.
Spread the mixture in a baking dish. Top with the remaining marinara sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 20-25 minutes, until bubbly.
Hard boil the eggs, peel, and set aside.
In a pan, heat oil and sauté finely chopped onions until golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for a minute.
Add finely chopped tomatoes, turmeric, and chili powder. Cook until tomatoes are soft and oil separates.
Add a little water to make a gravy. Add the boiled eggs (you can halve them or make slits in them).
Simmer for 5-7 minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve.
Slice carrots and place them in a saucepan.
Add orange juice, butter, sugar, and salt.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender and the glaze has thickened.
Serve warm.
Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, turmeric, and garam masala for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken until cooked through.
For the sauce, melt butter in a large pot. Sauté onions, garlic, and ginger.
Add pureed tomatoes and cashews. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend the sauce until smooth. Return to the pot, add cream, and simmer.
Add the cooked chicken to the sauce and heat through. Serve with naan or rice.
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out excess water.
In a bowl, mix the zucchini, corn, flour, egg, baking powder, and finely chopped onion.
Season with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a pan and drop spoonfuls of the batter. Fry until golden brown on both sides.
Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces and toss with soy sauce and cornstarch.
In a hot wok, stir-fry the chicken until cooked. Remove from wok.
Sauté onion, bell pepper, and garlic until tender.
Return chicken to the wok, add a generous amount of freshly ground black pepper and a splash more soy sauce.
Toss everything together and serve hot.
Slice eggplant into 1/2-inch rounds and salt them. Let sit for 30 minutes, then pat dry.
Dip slices in beaten egg, then coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry in olive oil until golden brown on both sides.
Layer fried eggplant, tomato sauce, and cheese in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 minutes until cheese is bubbly.
Cut eggplants in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic until softened.
Add diced tomato and the scooped eggplant flesh. Cook for 10 minutes.
Fill the eggplant shells with the mixture.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes until tender.
Roast whole eggplant at 400°F until completely soft and charred, about 40 minutes.
Scoop out the flesh and mash with minced garlic and lemon juice.
Season with salt and drizzle with olive oil.
Serve as a dip with pita bread.
Cube the eggplant and soak in salted water for 15 minutes.
Sauté chopped onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add drained eggplant cubes and simmer for 20 minutes.
Season with salt, turmeric, and chili powder. Serve with rice.
Slice eggplant and grill until charred and tender.
Dice tomato, cucumber, and onion.
Chop grilled eggplant and combine with the vegetables.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Cut meat into cubes and brown in a hot pot with oil.
Add diced onion and cook until softened.
Add cubed potatoes and sliced carrots.
Cover with water or broth and simmer for 1.5 hours until meat is tender.
Season with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Slice meat thinly against the grain.
Stir-fry meat in a hot wok until browned. Remove and set aside.
Stir-fry sliced bell pepper, onion, and carrot until tender-crisp.
Return meat to the wok and toss with soy sauce.
Serve hot over rice.
Slice meat thinly and stir-fry until browned.
Add sliced onion and minced garlic, cook for 2 minutes.
Add shredded cabbage and stir-fry for 5 minutes until wilted.
Season with soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Serve hot.
Sauté chopped onion until golden brown.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until they break down into a sauce.
Season with salt, turmeric, chili powder, and cumin.
Simmer for 10 minutes. Serve with rice or bread.
Peel and thinly slice potatoes and onions.
Heat oil in a pan and add the potatoes. Fry until golden.
Add sliced onions and cook until softened.
Season with salt, pepper, and cumin. Serve as a side dish.
Dice carrots, potatoes, and onion.
Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Add carrots and potatoes, cover with water or broth.
Simmer until vegetables are very tender, about 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.
Finely shred the cabbage and grate the carrots.
Toss together in a large bowl.
Dress with a mixture of vinegar, oil, sugar, salt, and pepper.
Let sit for 15 minutes before serving.
Cut broccoli and cauliflower into florets and steam until just tender.
Place in a baking dish.
Make a cheese sauce with butter, flour, milk, and grated cheese.
Pour sauce over vegetables and top with more cheese.
Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Cut broccoli into small florets.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat.
Add minced garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add broccoli and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Slice cucumber and tomato. Thinly slice onion.
Combine in a bowl.
Dress with olive oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
Serve chilled.
Boil and cube the potatoes.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic until golden.
Add washed spinach and cook until wilted.
Add the potato cubes and season with salt, cumin, and chili.
Cook together for 5 minutes. Serve with flatbread.
Cut corn kernels off the cob. Dice bell pepper and onion.
Sauté onion in butter until soft.
Add bell pepper and cook for 3 minutes.
Add corn and cook for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lime.
Pulse cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice.
Scramble the egg in a hot pan. Set aside.
Sauté diced onion and carrot until tender.
Add cauliflower rice and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in scrambled egg and season with soy sauce.
Cut tomatoes into wedges.
Scramble eggs in a hot pan and set aside.
Sauté tomato wedges until soft and saucy.
Add scrambled eggs back and toss together.
Season with salt, sugar, and a splash of soy sauce.
Peel and cut potatoes and carrots into chunks.
Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, and rosemary.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 35-40 minutes, turning once, until golden and crispy.
Slice potatoes thinly and shred cabbage.
Fry potato slices until lightly golden.
Add sliced onion and cook until soft.
Add shredded cabbage and stir-fry until wilted.
Season with salt, cumin, and chili flakes.
Slice bell peppers and onions into strips.
Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add peppers and onions and cook for 8-10 minutes until softened and slightly charred.
Season with salt, pepper, and oregano. Serve as a side or in fajitas.
Boil and cube the potatoes.
Sauté chopped onion until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until saucy.
Add potatoes and peas. Season with turmeric, cumin, and chili.
Simmer for 10 minutes. Garnish with cilantro.
Clean and slice mushrooms.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.
Add mushrooms and cook for 6-8 minutes until golden.
Season with salt, pepper, and fresh parsley.
Beat eggs with a splash of milk and season with salt and pepper.
Sauté sliced mushrooms until golden. Add spinach and wilt.
Remove vegetables and set aside.
Pour eggs into the hot pan and cook until set on bottom.
Add vegetables to one half, fold omelette over, and serve.
Break cauliflower into florets.
Toss with olive oil, minced garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread on a baking sheet.
Roast at 425°F (220°C) for 25-30 minutes until golden and caramelized.
Squeeze lemon juice over the top before serving.
Sauté chopped onion and grated ginger until fragrant.
Add sliced carrots and cover with broth.
Simmer for 20 minutes until carrots are very tender.
Blend until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with a swirl of cream.
Dice tomato and onion.
Sauté onion until soft, then add tomato and cook until saucy.
Beat eggs and pour over the tomato-onion mixture.
Scramble everything together until eggs are cooked.
Season and serve with toast.
Dice potatoes and fry until golden and crisp.
Add diced onion and cook until soft.
Add spinach and stir until wilted.
Make wells in the hash and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until eggs are set. Serve hot.
Dice tomato, onion, and bell pepper.
Sauté the vegetables until softened.
Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Pour eggs over vegetables and cook until the bottom is set.
Fold in half and serve.
Slice eggplant into rounds.
Salt the slices and let sit for 20 minutes to draw out moisture. Pat dry.
Heat oil in a pan with sliced garlic until garlic is fragrant.
Fry eggplant slices until golden on both sides.
Serve with a squeeze of lemon.
Brown meat cubes in a pan. Set aside.
Slice and fry eggplant until golden.
Sauté onion, then add chopped tomatoes to make a sauce.
Layer meat, eggplant, and tomato sauce in a baking dish.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30 minutes.
Peel and cube the pumpkin.
Sauté chopped onion and garlic until soft.
Add pumpkin cubes and cover with broth.
Simmer for 20 minutes until pumpkin is tender.
Blend until smooth. Season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Peel sweet potatoes and cut into fry shapes.
Toss with olive oil, salt, and paprika.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake at 425°F (220°C) for 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
Trim the green beans.
Blanch in boiling water for 3 minutes, then plunge into ice water.
Heat olive oil in a pan with minced garlic.
Add green beans and sauté for 3 minutes.
Squeeze lemon juice over them and season with salt and pepper.
Wash and slice okra into rounds.
Sauté sliced onion until golden.
Add okra and cook on medium-high heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add chopped tomato and cook for 5 more minutes.
Season with salt, turmeric, and chili powder.
Thinly slice radishes and cucumber.
Toss together in a bowl.
Dress with rice vinegar, sesame oil, salt, and a pinch of sugar.
Garnish with sesame seeds and serve chilled.
Trim the woody ends of asparagus.
Melt butter in a skillet and add minced garlic.
Add asparagus and cook for 5-7 minutes until tender-crisp.
Season with salt, pepper, and a squeeze of lemon.
Cube potatoes and break cauliflower into florets.
Sauté sliced onion until golden.
Add chopped tomato and cook until soft.
Add potatoes and cauliflower with turmeric, cumin, and chili powder.
Cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes until tender.
Blanch spinach and blend into a smooth puree.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook until soft.
Stir in spinach puree and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add cubed cheese and cook for 5 more minutes. Serve with rice or naan.
Cook rice and let it cool completely (day-old rice works best).
Scramble eggs in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry diced carrot, peas, and onion until tender.
Add cold rice and toss on high heat for 3-4 minutes.
Stir in scrambled eggs and season with soy sauce.
Cook rice ahead of time and let it cool.
Beat eggs and scramble in a hot wok. Set aside.
Sauté diced onion until translucent.
Add rice and stir-fry on high heat.
Mix in scrambled eggs, season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Cook and cool rice. Dice chicken breast.
Stir-fry chicken until cooked through. Set aside.
Scramble eggs and set aside.
Sauté diced carrot and onion.
Add rice, chicken, and eggs. Toss with soy sauce on high heat.
Slice mushrooms and dice onion.
Sauté onion and garlic in butter until soft.
Add mushrooms and cook until golden brown.
Add broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend partially for a chunky soup. Season with salt and pepper.
Slice leeks and dice potatoes and onion.
Sauté leeks and onion in butter until soft.
Add potatoes and cover with broth.
Simmer for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender.
Blend until smooth. Serve with a dollop of cream.
Dice tomatoes and mix with minced garlic and chopped basil.
Season with salt, pepper, and olive oil.
Let marinate for 15 minutes.
Toast bread slices and top with the tomato mixture.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar and serve.
Sauté diced onion, bell pepper, and garlic until soft.
Add chopped tomatoes and cook into a thick sauce.
Season with cumin, paprika, and chili flakes.
Make wells in the sauce and crack eggs into them.
Cover and cook until eggs are set. Serve with bread.
Dice cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
Combine in a large bowl.
Add cubed feta cheese and olives.
Dress with olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Toss gently and serve chilled.
Slice tomatoes and fresh mozzarella into rounds.
Arrange alternating slices on a plate.
Tuck fresh basil leaves between slices.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
Dice eggplant, zucchini, bell pepper, and onion into similar-sized cubes.
Sauté onion until soft, then add bell pepper.
Add eggplant and zucchini, cook for 5 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and herbs (thyme, basil).
Simmer on low for 30 minutes. Season and serve.
Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Cook rice and mix with sautéed onion and diced tomato.
Season the filling with salt, pepper, and herbs.
Stuff the peppers with the rice mixture.
Bake at 375°F for 30 minutes until peppers are tender.
Hollow out bell peppers.
Brown the meat with diced onion.
Mix meat with cooked rice and chopped tomato.
Fill peppers with the mixture.
Top with cheese and bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.
Thinly slice potatoes using a mandoline.
Rub a baking dish with garlic and butter.
Layer potato slices, seasoning each layer with salt, pepper, and cheese.
Pour cream over the top.
Bake at 375°F for 45 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté minced garlic in butter until fragrant.
Add cream and simmer for 3 minutes.
Toss in pasta and grated cheese.
Stir until creamy. Season with salt and pepper.
Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté sliced carrots, broccoli, and bell pepper until tender-crisp.
Add diced tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes.
Toss vegetables with pasta.
Drizzle with olive oil and top with parmesan.
Season salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
Sear skin-side down in a hot pan for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for 3 more minutes.
Add butter, garlic, and lemon juice to the pan.
Baste salmon with the sauce and serve.
Cut chicken into pieces and season with salt.
Sear chicken in a hot pan until golden.
Add minced garlic and ginger, cook for 1 minute.
Pour in a mixture of honey, soy sauce, and water.
Simmer until sauce thickens and coats the chicken.
Season and brown chicken pieces in a pot.
Remove chicken and sauté onion and carrot.
Add rice and toast for 1 minute.
Return chicken, add broth, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook for 20 minutes until rice is done.
Drain canned tuna and flake into a bowl.
Dice onion and cucumber finely.
Mix together with mayonnaise.
Season with salt, pepper, and lemon juice.
Serve on bread or with crackers.
Cut broccoli into small florets and blanch briefly.
Sauté minced garlic in oil.
Add shrimp and cook until pink.
Add broccoli and toss together.
Season with soy sauce and serve over rice.
Slice chicken and stir-fry until golden.
Remove and sauté garlic briefly.
Add broccoli florets and stir-fry until bright green.
Return chicken and toss with a sauce of soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Serve over rice.
Slice pork thinly.
Stir-fry pork in a hot wok until browned.
Add minced garlic and ginger.
Add shredded cabbage and cook until wilted.
Season with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Brown lamb cubes in oil.
Sauté onion until golden.
Add chopped tomato and spices (cumin, coriander, turmeric).
Add potatoes and water, simmer for 1 hour until lamb is tender.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice.
Dice potatoes and cook in a skillet until golden.
Add diced beef and brown.
Add chopped onion and cook until soft.
Season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Press down to form a crispy crust. Serve with eggs on top.
Spiralize zucchini into noodles.
Sauté minced garlic in olive oil.
Add diced tomatoes and simmer into a sauce.
Add zucchini noodles and toss for 2 minutes.
Season with basil, salt, and pepper.
Hard boil eggs and slice.
Wash and dry baby spinach.
Thinly slice red onion.
Arrange spinach on a plate, top with egg and onion.
Dress with olive oil and vinegar.
Roast beets at 400°F for 45 minutes until tender.
Peel and slice the beets.
Arrange on a bed of spinach.
Crumble cheese over the top.
Dress with balsamic vinaigrette.
Rinse lentils.
Sauté diced onion and carrot until soft.
Add lentils, chopped tomato, and broth.
Simmer for 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season with cumin, salt, and lemon juice.
Rinse lentils and boil until soft.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until golden.
Add chopped tomato and cook until soft.
Add cooked lentils and season with turmeric, cumin, and chili.
